en: Dependent on an indeterminate limited state, an unwholesome and non-limited state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a wholesome exalted state, an unwholesome and non-exalted state arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Six under root; six under predominance; ... pe ... three under mutuality; ... pe ... three under result; ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a wholesome immeasurable state, a state that is neither wholesome nor immeasurable arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are six under root, six under predominance … pe … three under result … pe … six under non-disappearance.
